results.title: Gurwin residents enjoy 3rd annual ‘Dog Days of Summer’ show
results.description: Gurwin Jewish Nursing & Rehabilitation Center in Commack recently hosted its 3rd Annual Dog Days of Summer Fashion Show, welcoming pooches and their owners for a runway-style fashion show and pet therapy session. The annual event is highly anticipated by the Gurwin community and provided an afternoon of laughter and connection. The Canine Couture Fashion Show starred a dozen furry friends belonging to Gurwin staff, friends, and members of Fountaingate Gardens, Gurwin’s independent living Life Plan Community. An added bonus to the celebration was a visit by The Guide Dog Foundation, featuring puppies-in-training, who showed off impressive skills and focus. “Our annual dog show is part of Gurwin’s ongoing commitment to enriching resident quality of life through meaningful programs like pet therapy,” said Nicole Hopper, Chief Therapeutic Officer of the Gurwin Healthcare System. “A wagging tail, gentle nuzzle and playful paw in the hand make a real impact on our residents’ well-being. Our staff loved sharing their beloved dogs with the residents, and the addition of the service dog interaction brought even more joy to the celebration.” Each four-legged participant went home with a goodie bag of homemade dog treats. The event was held in Gurwin’s newly remodeled Simon Rainbow Room, where immersive projections of playful summer visuals set the scene for a joyful afternoon of canine charm.
